chunks: And the earth throws out its burdens,

key_terms.أَثْقَالَهَا: Its burdens (referring to the dead bodies)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the earth throws out its burdens on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as the earth vomiting forth the 'heavy loads' of the dead, a physical manifestation of the cosmic upheaval preceding the final judgment. This event underscores the absolute power of Allah to restore creation and serves as a reminder for believers to prepare their deeds, linking the physical resurrection to the spiritual accountability emphasized in the concept of *Ma'ad* (Return).
